newsitem.title: SPAIN: CYCLING-INDURAIN RETIRING, PREDICT TEAM CHIEFS.
newsitem.headline: CYCLING-INDURAIN RETIRING, PREDICT TEAM CHIEFS.

text.p: Five-times Tour de France winner Miguel Indurain is likely to retire, two leading team managers predicted on Thursday.
Indurain has still to make up his mind two months after pulling out of the Tour of Spain.
But Pablo Anton, a manager of the ONCE team which has put in a bid for the services of the Banesto team leader, said: "Before I thought the opposite, but now I believe he will decide to stop."

Banesto director Eusebio Unzue echoed: "I think that Indurain will opt to retire." But, speculating that Indurain was not really sure what to do, he added: "If he had totally decided to retire, he would have said so."

Indurain hinted two months ago he would decide whether to quit or not after returning from holiday. But nearly a week has passed since he arrived back from the Caribbean and still there is no word from Spain's greatest sporting hero.
